title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_quick_and_easy_way_to_effective_speaking_by_dale_carnegie_0ley1 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_quick_and_easy_way_to_effective_speaking_by_dale_carnegie_0ley1' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted system. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
